title: Leukapheresis_Donor_1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Genetically modified T cells were generated using the CliniMacs Prodigy (Milteny) following manufacturer’s instructions. Transduction was performed using an APRIL-CAR retroviral vector as previously described (PMID 29284597).
growth_protocol_ch1: MM.1S cells were obtained from ATCC (CRL-2974) and cultured in RPMI (Lonza) supplemented with 10% FBS (Gibco) and 1% Glutamax (Gibco). Leukapheresis samples were thawed, washed and seeded at a concentration of 2x10e6 cells/ml in TexMacs (Miltenyi) supplemented with human AB serum (Seralab) and IL-7 and IL-15 (Miltenyi) in 24 well plates.   Similarly, product samples were thawed, washed and resuspended at a concentration of 1x 10e5 CAR+ cells/ml in 0.5 ml of culture media and cultured for 24 hours in 48 well plates. For the antigen-exposure experiments, product samples were co-cultured in the presence of MM1.s cells in a 1:1 effector (CAR+ cells)/target (MM1.s) ratio.
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were derived from healthy donors leukapheresis. Peripheral blood leukapaheresis were obtained from the NHS as part of a research study (IRAS ID 185945) or purchased as Leuko Paks from AllCells.
Samples were processed following manufacturer’s recommendations for Chromium Single Cell 3′ Library & Gel Bead Kit v2 (10X Genomics).
data_processing: Reads aligned to hg19 and processed using Cell Ranger v2.0.0. The expected number of cells was set to 10,000.
The downstream analysis was done using Scanpy (version 0.2.3).
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: h5 files from Cell Ranger output with UMI count matrix, gene names and cell barcodes
contact_institute: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine
